messages:
Lina (partnerships): Kicking off the publisher starter kit thread. Need a single package we can hand to AWS/GCP/Azure teams + partners. Wants: manifest templates, tile variants, telemetry/usage hooks, and onboarding contact flow. Who can help own tiles vs manifests?
Noah (solutions): I can take telemetry hooks and onboarding flow. Quick Q: do we want raw usage metrics or aggregated billing events sent to vendor portals?
Lina (partnerships): Aggregated + categorized events preferred. Vendors ask for SKU-level usage estimates. Keep raw logs internal.
Yara (design): I'll mock 2 tile sizes: compact and feature. Compact shows headline + 2 badges. Feature has 3 bullets + screenshot. ETA tomorrow AM.
Omar (eng): For manifest templates: each cloud needs slightly different fields. I'll provide 3 minimal manifests and a sample healthcheck + readiness probe. Also will add example env var set for marketplace credentials.
Eli (legal): Heads-up: marketplace terms must reference our regional privacy addendum. Also need clear trial termination billing language. Lina, can you confirm trial length?
Lina (partnerships): 14-day trial across all clouds. Offer: trial auto-converts unless canceled. Include marketplace-support@redwood.ai for escalations.
Noah (solutions): Telemetry plan draft: emit SKU.name, region, tokens_in, tokens_out, inference_ms bucketed, and error_count. We will expose a redwood.telemetry endpoint (POST) for vendor ingestion. Can Omar add a sample payload?
Omar (eng): Sample payload:
```
{
  "sku": "redwood-dedicated-1mo",
  "region": "eu-west1",
  "tokens_in": 12345,
  "tokens_out": 9876,
  "p95_latency_ms": 143,
  "error_count": 2,
  "window_start": "2025-04-10T08:00:00Z"
}
```
Will also add HMAC header example for auth.
Eli (legal): Good. For Azure private offers we must include a clause: "Customer data remains in customer-controlled VPCs unless otherwise agreed". I'll draft a one-liner for the tile footnote.
Yara (design): For badges: "EU data controls", "SLA-backed". Badges are small so keep short. Also adding a tiny lock icon for Private SKU.
Lina (partnerships): Nice. Noah: onboarding flow?
Noah (solutions): Flow: 1) Partner clicks Start trial -> 2) Marketplace collects contact -> 3) We trigger onboarding email with staging access + manifest instructions -> 4) Partner confirms publish checklist. I'll write the email template.
Omar (eng): Publisher actions doc will include: create service account, grant role:marketplace-publisher, upload container/AMI, health endpoint test, telemetry webhook setup. I'll add sample CLI commands.
Lina (partnerships): Can we keep the initial public metadata minimal to speed approval? We can add deeper entitlements later. Aim for smallest viable listing.
Eli (legal): Agree. Minimal metadata + links to EULA/privacy addendum and support email. I'll attach the one-line legal blurb by EOD.
Yara (design): Uploading tile PNGs to shared drive now. Also attaching alt text for accessibility.
onboarding-bot: Starter-kit checklist updated: manifests drafted false -> true; tiles uploaded false -> true; legal blurb pending.
Lina (partnerships): Great progress. Action items: Omar adds manifest samples + CLI, Noah finalizes telemetry + email template, Eli finalizes legal blurb, Yara finalizes PNGs. We'll loop vendor PMs after staging is set up. :party_parrot:
Noah (solutions): I'll post telemetry spec and sample ingestion test in this thread when ready.
Omar (eng): Will push manifests to repo and ping #eng-runtime for review.
Eli (legal): I'll drop the tile footnote and trial sentence by 3pm PT.
Lina (partnerships): Thanks team — this will speed cloud approvals.
